label: first copy step (just after <DEL>), strongest for long sequences or when the first token is j/p
explanation: Mainly fires on the step right after <DEL>, where the input is the first original token fed back and the model outputs original token 1 (recall_idx==1). This step holds about 76% of activation mass and fires on 38% of such steps. The firing rate and magnitude rise with sequence length (L=9 carries half the mass, L>=7 gives 63% precision), and the top activations (about 0.12) are all where the fed-back first token is j or p. A weaker secondary mode fires when j or p is input early in the original phase (positions 1-2). There is also a diffuse weak tail late in the copy phase of long sequences and at the <DEL> step. It never fires at t=0, almost never at original positions 3+, and rarely at copy steps recall_idx 2-5. Output token identity matters little.
